constant volume past 30-40 minutes causes listening fatigue and this is a 100 hour game, so never 'turn it on and leave it on'; keep detail out of the loop and scatter it as randomized one-shots

the_target_from_school.real_floor_dBA: wilderness 30-40 and seldom below 30-35; quiet suburb 45-50; city 60-70; night about 7 under day
the_target_from_school.a_dead_city_is_only: 5 to 7 dB below a live one (Montreal 6-7, Ruhr 5.1, heavy traffic only 3-5 despite half the traffic gone)
the_target_from_school.so_the_fix_is: not a volume. take the machines out of the keynote and let what was always underneath come up: wind on concrete, a loose sign, a dog four blocks off, birds that were always there and always masked.
